title: Post-Collision Velocity v1 in 1D Head-on Elastic Collision
latex: v_1 = \left(\frac{m_1 - m_2}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_1 + \left(\frac{2 m_2}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_2

variables.v_1: Final velocity of mass 1 after elastic collision
variables.u_1, u_2: Initial velocities of masses 1 and 2 before collision

validity_conditions: Valid for any mass ratio m1/m2 and initial velocities u1, u2
common_misuse: Swapping m1 and m2 in the first coefficient
Forgetting vector signs when bodies travel in opposite directions
source_provenance: HCV1 Ch 9 p. 166 eq. 9.22; HRW Ch 9 p. 247; UP Ch 8 p. 280
equation_latex: v_1 = \left(\frac{m_1 - m_2}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_1 + \left(\frac{2 m_2}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_2
